model.name: gpt-oss-20b (agent)
model.about: OpenAI, mixture of experts (3.6B active), MXFP4 as released. The model approved today; the baseline every other profile is read against.

answers.sql:
WITH txn AS (
  SELECT ch.CHNL_K, ch.DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON t.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY ch.CHNL_K, ch.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT chnl_k, dsply_nm AS channel, txn_count
FROM txn
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

WITH alerts AS (
  SELECT a.JUR_K, d.CAL_YR_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction, COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM alerts a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT br.BUS_ID, br.DSPLY_NM, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND br.IS_CURR
)
SELECT BUS_ID, DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM txn
GROUP BY BUS_ID, DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH last_day AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-08-01' AND '2025-08-31' AND IS_MTH_END
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fd.CUST_K) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D fd
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON fd.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN last_day ld ON d.DT_K = ld.DT_K
WHERE fd.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

WITH complaints AS (
  SELECT f.CMPLT_CTG_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT ct.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
       COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM complaints c
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ct ON c.CMPLT_CTG_K = ct.CMPLT_CTG_K
GROUP BY ct.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

WITH august_dates AS (
  SELECT MAX(DT_K) AS last_day_key
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT >= '2023-08-01' AND CAL_DT < '2023-09-01'
),
  defaults AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d
    JOIN august_dates a ON d.BUS_DT_K = a.last_day_key
    WHERE d.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
  )
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM defaults;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
)
SELECT
  f.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
  AVG(f.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY avg_daily_rate DESC;

WITH opened AS (
  SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1, COUNT(DISTINCT ACCT_K) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
  WHERE OPND_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
)
SELECT * FROM opened;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT d.CTY_NM AS city, f.ATM_TXN_F_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d ON f.BR_K = d.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31'
)
SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM txn
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT AVG(a.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12;

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month, COUNT(*) AS disputes
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY customer_count DESC;

WITH curr_customers AS (
  SELECT CUST_K FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
), txns_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_no_txn_2025
FROM curr_customers c
LEFT JOIN txns_2025 t ON c.CUST_K = t.CUST_K
WHERE t.CUST_K IS NULL;

WITH totals AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
), declined AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS declined
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 AND a.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED'
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * declined / total, 2) AS declined_pct
FROM declined, totals;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS category,
       COUNT(*) AS escalated_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = true
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_count DESC;

SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_txn_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD';

WITH f AS (
  SELECT JUR_K, ALRT_SVRTY_CD1, BUS_DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT
  WHERE ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
), d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
)
SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
       COUNT(*) AS high_alerts_2025
FROM f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY high_alerts_2025 DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans_over_90
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31' AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

WITH mobile_txn AS (
  SELECT f.BUS_DT_K, f.TXN_CNT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL d ON f.CHNL_K = d.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE d.CHNL_TYP_CD1 = 'MOBILE' AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024,2025)
)
SELECT dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, SUM(mt.TXN_CNT) AS txn_count
FROM mobile_txn mt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON mt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
GROUP BY dt.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY dt.CAL_YR_NBR;

WITH target AS (
  SELECT f.LN_PRD_K, f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
       SUM(t.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM target t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p ON t.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
WHERE p.IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY p.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_outstanding_principal DESC;

WITH wr AS (
  SELECT c.BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
    AND f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = true
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS distinct_sme_crossborder_customers
FROM wr;

WITH txn_counts AS (
  SELECT d_br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
         d_br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
         d_br.BR_K,
         COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d_br ON f.BR_K = d_br.BR_K
  WHERE d_dt.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
    AND d_br.IS_CURR = true
  GROUP BY d_br.RGN_CD1, d_br.DSPLY_NM, d_br.BR_K
), ranked AS (
  SELECT region_code, branch_name, txn_cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_code ORDER BY txn_cnt DESC) AS rn
  FROM txn_counts
)
SELECT region_code, branch_name, txn_cnt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT d.MRCH_CTG_CD1, f.ORGNL_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH d ON f.MRCH_K = d.MRCH_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code, SUM(ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM auth
GROUP BY MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH cust AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, BUS_ID FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_CURR=true
), trf AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, SUM(STLM_AMT) AS total FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON F_WR_TRF.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR=2025
  GROUP BY CUST_K
)
SELECT c.BUS_ID, t.total
FROM trf t JOIN cust c ON t.CUST_K=c.CUST_K
ORDER BY t.total DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT d.CAL_DT, f.STLM_AMT, f.STLM_CCY_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT)=2025
)
SELECT STLM_CCY_CD1 AS currency, SUM(STLM_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM t
GROUP BY STLM_CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

WITH wire AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
), atm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM (
  SELECT CUST_K FROM wire
  INTERSECT
  SELECT CUST_K FROM atm
) t;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024,2025)
  GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT year, cnt FROM t ORDER BY year;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT
  c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency,
  SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
GROUP BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY total_volume DESC;

SELECT ch.CHNL_K, ch.DSPLY_NM, SUM(f.TXN_CNT) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON f.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ch.CHNL_K, ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

WITH alerts AS (
  SELECT a.AML_ALRT_F_K, j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT jurisdiction, COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM alerts
GROUP BY jurisdiction
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT f.BR_K, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND d.CAL_DT < '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT b.BUS_ID, b.DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM txn t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON t.BR_K = b.BR_K AND b.IS_CURR
GROUP BY b.BUS_ID, b.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH last_day AS (
  SELECT MAX(BUS_DT_K) AS last_dt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
  WHERE TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(BUS_DT_K::text, 'YYYYMMDD')),'YYYY-MM')='2025-08'
), defaults AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
  JOIN last_day ld ON f.BUS_DT_K = ld.last_dt
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON f.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
  WHERE f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE AND d.IS_CURR = TRUE
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM defaults;

WITH f AS (
  SELECT f.CMPLT_CTG_K, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS category, COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

WITH august_dates AS (
  SELECT MAX(DT_K) AS max_dt
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE MTH_NBR = 8
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN august_dates a ON f.BUS_DT_K = a.max_dt
WHERE f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT f.CCY_CD1 AS currency, AVG(f.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY avg_daily_rate DESC;

WITH current_accounts AS (
  SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
  WHERE IS_CURR = true
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM OPND_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1, COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM current_accounts
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT b.CTY_NM,
         COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON a.BR_K = b.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31'
  GROUP BY b.CTY_NM
)
SELECT CTY_NM,
       atm_txn_count
FROM txn
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT AVG(CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_YR_NBR, MTH_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
)
SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
       COUNT(*) AS disputes
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY customer_count DESC;

WITH current_customers AS (
  SELECT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
), txns_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_no_txn_2025
FROM current_customers cc
LEFT JOIN txns_2025 tx ON cc.CUST_K = tx.CUST_K
WHERE tx.CUST_K IS NULL;

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT f.PMT_STS_CD1, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT)=2025
)
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN PMT_STS_CD1='DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_declined
FROM auth;

WITH escalated AS (
  SELECT d.DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS escalated_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = true
    AND dt.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY d.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT DSPLY_NM, escalated_count
FROM escalated
ORDER BY escalated_count DESC;

SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_txn_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD';

WITH f AS (
  SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
         COUNT(*) AS alert_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT * FROM f;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans_over_90
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31' AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON t.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
  WHERE c.DSPLY_NM ILIKE '%Mobile App%'
    AND d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024,2025)
  GROUP BY yr
)
SELECT yr, cnt FROM txn ORDER BY yr;

WITH bal AS (
  SELECT f.LN_PRD_K, f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
       SUM(b.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bal b
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p ON b.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
WHERE p.IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY p.DSPLY_NM;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = true
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_sme_customers
FROM t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND c.IS_CURR = true;

WITH txn_counts AS (
  SELECT f.BR_K, COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY f.BR_K
), ranked AS (
  SELECT tc.*, b.RGN_CD1, b.DSPLY_NM,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.RGN_CD1 ORDER BY tc.txn_cnt DESC) AS rn
  FROM txn_counts tc
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON tc.BR_K = b.BR_K
  WHERE b.IS_CURR
)
SELECT RGN_CD1, DSPLY_NM, txn_cnt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY RGN_CD1;

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT a.ORGNL_AMT, d.MRCH_CTG_CD1, dt.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH d ON a.MRCH_K = d.MRCH_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON a.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND dt.CAL_DT < '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT MRCH_CTG_CD1, SUM(ORGNL_AMT) AS total
FROM auth
GROUP BY MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH cust AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = true
), trf AS (
  SELECT f.CUST_K, f.STLM_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT c.BUS_ID, SUM(t.STLM_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM trf t
JOIN cust c ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT f.CCY_CD1, f.STLM_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT CCY_CD1, SUM(STLM_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM t
GROUP BY CCY_CD1
ORDER BY CCY_CD1;

WITH wire AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
), atm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM (
  SELECT CUST_K FROM wire
  INTERSECT
  SELECT CUST_K FROM atm
) t;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_YR_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
)
SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS wire_transfers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT f.CCY_CD1, SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_volume DESC;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT d.CHNL_K, d.DSPLY_NM, f.TXN_CNT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL d ON f.CHNL_K = d.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT CHNL_K, DSPLY_NM, SUM(TXN_CNT) AS total_txn
FROM txn
GROUP BY CHNL_K, DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_txn DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS active_customers
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_ACTV = TRUE
  AND IS_CURR = TRUE;

WITH alerts AS (
  SELECT a.AML_ALRT_F_K, d.CAL_DT, j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction
  FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT jurisdiction, COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM alerts
GROUP BY jurisdiction
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT br.BUS_ID, br.DSPLY_NM, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT BUS_ID, DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM txn
GROUP BY BUS_ID, DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT t ON d.BUS_DT_K = t.DT_K
WHERE t.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH last_day AS (
  SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.CUST_K) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d
JOIN last_day ld ON d.BUS_DT_K = ld.DT_K
WHERE d.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

WITH d AS (SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT FROM bank_dwh.D_DT) SELECT d2.CMPLT_CTG_K, d2.DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS complaint_count FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d2 ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d2.CMPLT_CTG_K JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY d2.CMPLT_CTG_K, d2.DSPLY_NM;

WITH last_day AS (
  SELECT MAX(bus_dt_k) AS max_dt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
  WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM (bus_dt_k::text)::date) = 8
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cust_k) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D d
JOIN last_day ld ON d.bus_dt_k = ld.max_dt
WHERE d.dflt_flg = true;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT
  f.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
  ROUND(AVG(f.MID_RT), 8) AS avg_daily_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
       COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE IS_CURR = true
  AND OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND OPND_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT d.CTY_NM AS city, f.*
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d ON f.BR_K = d.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31'
)
SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM txn
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

WITH target AS (
  SELECT f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30'
)
SELECT AVG(CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM target;

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, MTH_NBR, CAL_YR_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
       COUNT(*) AS disputes
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

WITH cur AS (
  SELECT BUS_ID, CUST_SGMNT_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = true
    AND IS_ACTV = true
)
SELECT
  CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM cur
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH custs AS (
  SELECT CUST_K, BUS_ID FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_CURR = true
), txns AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_no_txn_2025
FROM custs c
LEFT JOIN txns t ON c.CUST_K = t.CUST_K
WHERE t.CUST_K IS NULL;

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT 1 AS total,
         CASE WHEN PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS declined
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(declined) / SUM(total), 2) AS pct_declined
FROM auth;

WITH f AS (
  SELECT f.CMPLT_CTG_K, f.IS_ESCLT, d.CAL_YR_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS category_name, COUNT(*) AS escalated_count
FROM f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_count DESC;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT t.FEE_AMT, d.CAL_DT, c.DSPLY_NM
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND d.CAL_DT <= '2025-12-31'
    AND c.IS_CURR = true
)
SELECT DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, SUM(FEE_AMT) AS total_fees
FROM txn
GROUP BY DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_fees DESC;

SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_txn_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD';

WITH f AS (
  SELECT a.JUR_K, a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1, d.CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS high_alerts
FROM f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY high_alerts DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans_over_90
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31' AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE c.DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App'
  GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT yr, cnt AS mobile_app_txns
FROM txn
ORDER BY yr;

SELECT d.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
       SUM(f.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD d ON f.LN_PRD_K = d.LN_PRD_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_outstanding_principal DESC;

WITH transfers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
    AND d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_sme_customers
FROM transfers t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
         br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
         COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY br.RGN_CD1, br.DSPLY_NM
), ranked AS (
  SELECT region_code,
         branch_name,
         txn_cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_code ORDER BY txn_cnt DESC) AS rn
  FROM txn
)
SELECT region_code,
       branch_name,
       txn_cnt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

WITH auth AS (
  SELECT f.MRCH_K, d.MRCH_CTG_CD1, f.ORGNL_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH d ON f.MRCH_K = d.MRCH_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code, SUM(ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM auth
GROUP BY MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT c.BUS_ID, SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_amt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND c.IS_CURR = true
  GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
)
SELECT BUS_ID, total_amt
FROM t
ORDER BY total_amt DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
       SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

WITH wire AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
atm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM (
  SELECT CUST_K FROM wire
  INTERSECT
  SELECT CUST_K FROM atm
) t;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024,2025)
  GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT year, cnt FROM t ORDER BY year;

SELECT DISTINCT dsplay_nm AS branch_name
FROM bank_dwh.D_BR
WHERE is_curr = true
ORDER BY dsplay_nm;

SELECT f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
       SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_volume DESC;
